test_cases.test_name: CSV Import and X-bar/R Chart Creation with Nelson Rules
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can import data from CSV files and create X-bar/R control charts with vendor-standard Nelson rules applied correctly.
prerequisites: System installed and configured
Test CSV file with 100k data points prepared
User with appropriate permissions logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the data import section and select CSV import option
test_steps.expected_result: CSV import interface is displayed with file selection dialog

test_steps.action: Upload the test CSV file containing 100k data points
test_steps.expected_result: File upload completes successfully within 5 seconds

test_steps.action: Select X-bar/R chart type and configure with default settings
test_steps.expected_result: Chart configuration panel opens with X-bar/R options available

test_steps.action: Enable vendor-standard Nelson rules and apply to the chart
test_steps.expected_result: Nelson rules are successfully enabled and visible in chart configuration

test_steps.action: Generate the X-bar/R chart with applied Nelson rules
test_steps.expected_result: Chart renders completely within 2 seconds with Nelson rule violations highlighted
data_to_capture: Number of Nelson rule violations detected

acceptance_criteria: CSV import completes within 5 seconds
All 100k data points are imported correctly
X-bar/R chart renders within 2 seconds
Nelson rules are properly applied and violations are visually indicated
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 211.68
GAMP 5 Category 3 requirements for standard software
data_integrity_requirements: Data integrity maintained during import process
Chart calculations based on accurate statistical methods
Nelson rule application consistent with statistical standards

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control and PDF Export Functionality
test_cases.objective: Verify the system properly implements role-based access control and supports standard PDF export functionality for different user roles.
prerequisites: System installed and configured
Multiple user accounts with different roles created
Sample control chart created and saved
PDF export functionality available

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with administrator role and create a sample control chart
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login and full access to chart creation features

test_steps.action: Export the created chart to PDF format using vendor standard export feature
test_steps.expected_result: PDF export completes successfully with chart data preserved

test_steps.action: Log out and log in as a user with read-only role
test_steps.expected_result: Successful login with restricted access permissions

test_steps.action: Attempt to access the previously created chart with read-only account
test_steps.expected_result: Chart is accessible in read-only mode without edit capabilities

test_steps.action: Attempt to export the chart to PDF with read-only account
test_steps.expected_result: PDF export succeeds with read-only data access
data_to_capture: PDF export functionality for read-only role

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify chart configuration with read-only account
test_steps.expected_result: Modification attempts are prevented by system security

acceptance_criteria: Role-based access control functions correctly
PDF export works for all authorized roles
Read-only access properly enforced for released datasets
No unauthorized modifications possible
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11.10
21 CFR Part 211.68
Data integrity requirements for electronic records
data_integrity_requirements: Access controls prevent unauthorized data modification
PDF exports maintain data accuracy and integrity
Audit trail functionality if available

test_cases.test_name: Performance Testing for Large Dataset Loading and Chart Rendering
test_cases.objective: Verify the system meets performance requirements for loading large datasets and rendering charts within specified time limits
prerequisites: System installed and configured
Test CSV file with 100,000 data points prepared
Stopwatch or timing tool available
User with appropriate permissions logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the data import section and select the 100k data point CSV file for upload
test_steps.expected_result: System displays file selection dialog and accepts the CSV file

test_steps.action: Initiate the data import process and start timing
test_steps.expected_result: System begins processing the CSV file and displays progress indicator

test_steps.action: Record the time when data loading completes and charts are rendered
test_steps.expected_result: All 100,000 data points are loaded and charts are displayed within 5 seconds

test_steps.action: Apply filter changes to the loaded dataset and time the chart re-rendering
test_steps.expected_result: Charts update with filtered data and re-render within 2 seconds

acceptance_criteria: Data loading completes in less than 5 seconds
Chart rendering after filter changes completes in less than 2 seconds
No performance degradation or system crashes during testing
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records performance
GAMP 5 guidelines for performance verification
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurately loaded without corruption
Chart calculations must reflect the complete dataset accurately

test_cases.test_name: Integration Testing for CSV and ODBC Data Import Functionality

prerequisites: System installed and configured
Test CSV file with sample QC data
ODBC data source configured and accessible

test_steps.expected_result: System displays CSV import interface with file selection dialog

test_steps.action: Upload the test CSV file and configure import settings
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the file and displays configuration options for mapping data fields

test_steps.action: Complete the CSV import process and verify data integrity
test_steps.expected_result: Data is successfully imported and appears correctly in the dashboard with all values preserved

test_steps.action: Navigate to ODBC import option and configure connection to test database
test_steps.expected_result: System displays ODBC connection dialog and successfully connects to the data source

test_steps.action: Select data from ODBC source and complete import process
test_steps.expected_result: Data is successfully imported from ODBC source and matches source data exactly

acceptance_criteria: CSV import completes successfully with all data preserved
ODBC import completes successfully with accurate data transfer
Both import methods produce identical chart outputs for equivalent datasets
No data corruption or loss during import processes

GAMP 5 guidelines for integration testing
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be transferred completely without loss
Data transformations must maintain accuracy and precision
Source data integrity must be preserved throughout import process

test_cases.test_name: Active Directory Integration and Role-Based Access Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system integrates with Active Directory for authentication and properly enforces role-based access controls
prerequisites: Active Directory test environment
Test users with different roles configured in AD
AD integration configured in the SPC dashboard

test_steps.action: Attempt to log in with valid AD credentials for a user with administrator role
test_steps.expected_result: System authenticates user and grants appropriate administrator access privileges

test_steps.action: Verify administrator can access all system functions including configuration changes
test_steps.expected_result: Administrator has full access to all dashboard features and configuration options

test_steps.action: Log out and attempt to log in with valid AD credentials for a user with viewer role
test_steps.expected_result: System authenticates user and grants limited viewer access privileges

test_steps.action: Verify viewer cannot access configuration or data modification functions
test_steps.expected_result: Viewer role has read-only access to charts and reports without edit capabilities

test_steps.action: Attempt to log in with invalid AD credentials
test_steps.expected_result: System rejects authentication attempt and displays appropriate error message

acceptance_criteria: Successful authentication with valid AD credentials
Proper role-based access control enforcement
Rejection of invalid credentials
Read-only access enforced for appropriate roles
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signatures and access controls
Data integrity access control requirements
data_integrity_requirements: User authentication must be secure and reliable
Access controls must prevent unauthorized data modification
User actions must be attributable to specific individuals
urs_requirements: URS-020-004: The dashboard shall allow role-based view access
URS-020-007: Read-only access for released datasets
URS-020-013: Integrate with AD for user authentication if supported by vendor

test_cases.test_name: Performance Test: Large Dataset Loading and Chart Rendering
